name: adaptation_memory
why: Rubric §7: feedback persists beyond one conversation and shapes the next plan — the control here is that unrelated exercises are unaffected.

must_exclude.reason: injury note from chat 5 days earlier persists in Nora's context

must_include.id: injury_note in LLM planning context payload
must_include.reason: memory mechanism is inspectable, not vibes — the entry is visible in 'What Nora knows' as a typed, dated INJURY row
adaptation is targeted, not a full random reshuffle

resolve_semantics.reason: marking the entry Resolved in 'What Nora knows' greys it out and removes its tags from the next generation's rails; only injury entries are resolvable (PRD R46)
deletion removes the entry from the next assembled payload with no regeneration required
